name: happykeywords
description: App Store keyword research (ASO) from your AI agent: ranks in 50+ countries, demand and difficulty estimates, listing audits and rewrites.
long_description: Connects your agent to HappyKeywords, a Mac app for App Store keywords. Ask which keywords to target, where your app ranks in 50+ countries and what to fix in your listing. Everything runs on your Mac. Needs HappyKeywords installed in /Applications (7-day free trial, then a one-time license; no subscription). Uploads to App Store Connect happen only after you approve a preview, and nothing is ever submitted for review.
